tags.description: List of m17n database tags (e.g., language codes like 'en', 'fr', or scripts like 'utf-8') to filter the database query. Corresponds to TAG0...TAG3 in m17n-db(1).

output_mode.description: The format of the output. 'path' returns absolute pathnames of matching database files. 'info' returns descriptive information about the database entries.
